# Free Kids Books

> > A free digital library offering children's books, educational workbooks, and textbooks under Creative Commons licenses for all ages.

Free Kids Books curates and distributes open educational resources including picture books from Pratham Books StoryWeaver, classic literature, science and math textbooks, and original children's stories. All content is freely accessible under Creative Commons licensing to support literacy and learning worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Creative Commons
- Pratham Books
- StoryWeaver
- Free ebooks
- Children's literature
- Picture books
- Early readers
- Middle grade
- Educational workbooks
- Open educational resources
- Chapter books
- Bilingual learning
- Science textbooks
- Mathematics curriculum

## Picture Books & Early Readers

- [The Day It Rained Fish](https://freekidsbooks.org/the-day-it-rained-fish): Level 2 illustrated story from Pratham Books StoryWeaver about raining fish
- [Magozwe Finds a Home](https://freekidsbooks.org/magozwe-finds-a-home): Level 2 African Storybook about street boy Magozwe achieving his dreams
- [The Story of Stories - Children's Picture Book](https://freekidsbooks.org/the-story-of-stories-childrens-book): Picture book by Roopa Pai about a bear writer following his dream
- [Stick's Master Piece](https://freekidsbooks.org/sticks-masterpiece): Rhyming picture book by Brothers Whim inspiring kids who feel they can't
- [Tania's Discovery](https://freekidsbooks.org/tanias-discovery): Early reader from Tania series by Kanika G about a gardening discovery
- [All Seasons - Early Reader](https://freekidsbooks.org/seasons-early-readers): Kindergarten rhyming book about seasons by Zehnya & Danielle Bruckert
- [Maya Fights For A Cause - Conservation theme picture book](https://freekidsbooks.org/maya-fights-for-a-cause-conservation-theme-picture-book): Environmental conservation picture book about Maya creating positive change

## Chapter Books & Classic Literature

- [Sarah Sues Santa](https://freekidsbooks.org/sarah-sues-santa): Christmas chapter book by P.J. Leonard about Sarah Pebbleton suing Santa
- [Moby Dick - The Whale](https://freekidsbooks.org/moby-dick): Herman Melville's classic novel about Captain Ahab's quest for the whale
- [What is Love - Children's Biography of Helen Keller](https://freekidsbooks.org/love-childrens-biography-helen-keller): Middle grade biography featuring Helen Keller's 'The Story of My Life'

## Educational & STEM Books

- [Talking in Twos - Binary Language](https://freekidsbooks.org/talking-twos-binary): Educational book teaching binary & programming basics from Pratham Books
- [Around the World with a Chilli - Fun Facts for Children](https://freekidsbooks.org/around-world-chilli-fun-facts-children): Educational Pratham book with fun facts about chilies and world history
- [Introduction to Biology - Wikijunior Science textbook](https://freekidsbooks.org/introduction-to-biology-by-wikijunior-science-textbook): Wikijunior biology textbook for elementary & middle grade students

## Textbooks & Academic Resources

- [Understanding Basic Music Theory for high school](https://freekidsbooks.org/understanding-music-theory-high-school-text): Music theory textbook by Catherine Schmidt-Hones, University of Illinois
- [Technical Science Grade 10 - Ukuqonda RSA](https://freekidsbooks.org/technical-science-grade-10-ukuqonda-rsa): Grade 10 technical science textbook from Ukuqonda RSA, South Africa
- [Area - Apprenticeship and Workplace Mathematics 10](https://freekidsbooks.org/area-apprenticeship-and-workplace-mathematics-10): Grade 10 area geometry lessons from Open School BC mathematics curriculum

## Workbooks & Activity Books

- [Hindi Alphabet Practice Workbook](https://freekidsbooks.org/hindi-alphabet-practice-workbook): Hindi alphabet practice workbook for bilingual children with tracing pages
- [Health and Safety Colouring Book](https://freekidsbooks.org/health-and-safety-colouring-book): Educational coloring book from Denver Environmental Health on safety basics

## Optional

- [Made With Creative Commons - an anthology by Creativecommons.org](https://freekidsbooks.org/made-with-creative-commons-an-anthology-by-creativecommons-org-cc-by-sa): Creative Commons anthology on open licensing & content sharing business models
